proof_body:
by
  intro p k _ K _ _ _ ζ hζ
  refine ⟨?_, IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ncard_primesOver_of_prime_pow p k K⟩
  have := IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.map_eq_span_zeta_sub_one_pow p k hζ
  simpa [Ideal.map_span] using this
target_source: ∀ (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p ^ (k + 1)} ℚ K] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (k + 1))), Ideal.span {((p : ℕ) : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)} = Ideal.span {hζ.toInteger - 1} ^ Module.finrank ℚ K ∧ ((Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).primesOver (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)).ncard = 1
